Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-otel; OTel SDK deps exact-pinned, cordis+dsh-session as peers.
Per-heading EN/ZH pairing hashes for the otel README.
Package contract: two caller-owned channels, explicit options, no ambient headers, best-effort delivery.
Chinese translation of the otel package README.
Ordinary-event channel: SDK count batching, observedTimestamp at enqueue, shutdown that always releases the exporter.
Cancellable got-based OTLP transport: no redirects, 5 retries on 429/502/503/504, 4 MiB response ceiling.
Stateless Cordis service ctx.otel that only creates channels; holds no queue, identity or connection.
Byte-bounded Session queue: 4 MB request ceiling, per-record measurement, refuse-not-truncate, watchdog that only warns.
Shared OTLP JSON HTTP transport; selfObsMeterProvider removed from the accepted options so metrics stay noop.
Real local-collector suite: agent release, TLS failure, oversized response, channel isolation, redirect refusal.
Session suite: type-level exclusion of selfObsMeterProvider, no ambient auth header, exact-fit byte limit, queue bound, watchdog.
Package tsconfig; include is src only, references cordis/cosmokit and core/session.
Per-heading EN/ZH pairing hashes for the telemetry group map.
Group map stating the split: consumers pick events/identity/redaction, transports own encoding and delivery.
Chinese translation of the telemetry group map.
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-generator; typescript is a runtime dep, zod only dev, ./tsdown subpath export.
Per-heading EN/ZH pairing hashes for the generator README (18 anchored sections).
Generator contract: opt-in exports, consumer-owned strictness, rejectBuildOutputs, stated limits.
Chinese translation of the generator README.
3468-line TS analyzer: face programs, compiler-independent model, Remote boundary analysis, write-mode source editing.
Package-local artifact writers shared by the plugin and bundle-free generation; removes stale Remote files.
Detects lib/ build outputs and unresolved workspace imports so analysis does not depend on compilation order.
Cordis projection: injected policy, fail-closed type-link gate, @mode/signature cross-checks, byte-stable page renderer.
Model-driven emitter: cached Zod factories, strict+normal codecs from one type, byte encoder without copying, TYPERT typed unknown.
Public API barrel; keeps the tsdown plugin behind a separate subpath.
Compiler-independent model: 24 type-node variants, target kinds, two-type Remote boundary, assertNever-exhaustive traversal.
Renders TypeScript text and declaration closures from the model only; fails loudly on every broken edge.
Tool-schema projection: all-or-nothing subset, closed objects on request, disjoint-union requirement, no weakened schemas.
Rolldown plugin: decorator lowering, worker-thread workspace generation, failures as values, one-claim emission.
Worker entry: hand-validated workerData, exactly one response message, normalises non-Error throws.
Workspace driver: discovery, analysis, emission, and the exact package.json publication contract check.
Generated 229 KB Vitest snapshot (6492 lines) of emitter output; header and first entry opened to identify it, not read line by line.
Generated 310-line host-face artifact left by an earlier test run and stale (schema: vs create:); first 40 lines opened to identify it.
Second generated copy of the same stale host-face artifact; first 15 lines opened to confirm it is generated output.
Negative-path contract suite, but BOTH describe blocks are describe.skip so the contracts are not enforced.
Byte-for-byte reproduction of every committed catalog artifact in both languages and the tool-cordis api-catalog.
Root manifest of the remote-model fixture workspace; no exports, resolution via tsconfig paths.
Domain fixture manifest exporting . and ./types from source; the TypertLookupMap/TypertContextMap owner.
Host-only Agent class plus the lookup and context map merges that make it a wire boundary.
AgentId string alias: the wire identity for both the lookup and the context.
Domain project config; emits declarations to lib/types so the build-output guard has something to detect.
Remote fixture manifest with the exact ./typert and ./remote publication shape validateExport demands.
GoalService with @Remote, @RemoteScope and a stream method; the canonical Remote service fixture.
Four request/result interfaces with readonly fields and JSDoc, used as Remote boundaries.
Remote project config referencing ../domain, which creates the cross-package type reference.
Shared compiler options; protocol aliased to a hand-written stub, packages aliased to source.
Host aggregate: files [] plus two project references, the whole face definition.
Hand-written narrowed stub of the protocol surface the fixture resolves the Remote symbols against.
7-line Cordis stub with empty Context and Events so every fixture declaration is a merge.
5-line root manifest for the type-model fixture workspace.
Client manifest declaring only ./client/typert, which makes it a dual-face package.
Client source covering all four cross-face reference forms plus a namespace and default import.
Client project config referencing ../host; face membership still comes from the aggregate.
Host manifest with three subpaths including a non-root ./models for boundary type imports.
Host fixture: @typert object class, aliased/default services, negative Context cases, duplicate merge, property-style event.
The type zoo: one declaration per retained node shape, from conditional and mapped to predicates and this.
Host project config; include is expanded, noEmit so it is a pure source project.
Write-mode fixture manifest with no Typert export, so it is not a contributor.
Write-mode fixture: unannotated property and defaulted parameter, the two shapes the writer must place.
Write project config, identical in shape to the host package's.
Shared fixture compiler options with paths mapping cordis and the three fixture packages.
Client aggregate referencing only the client package.
Host aggregate referencing only the host package; the two faces are separate programs.
Root config whose only job is to place cordis.d.ts via files.
Third aggregate used to point the analyzer at the write-mode package.
Remote metadata suite: generated .d.ts is type-checked against a consumer, schemas validated by dsh-tools' own validator.
Remote model suite: bytes survive without copy or freeze, recursive decoding, every Remote refusal pinned.
Helper that evaluates generated artifacts against the CURRENT protocol source via a data: URL.
Renderer suite: exact child-edge list for all 24 node kinds, optional shapes, every broken edge throws.
Zod projection matrix with an exhaustive type-level support map; unsupported kinds rejected by name.
Proves the generated dsh-tools artifact matches the committed model-facing catalog exactly.
Worker-mode integration: byte-equal to in-process generation, and the worker's error text reaches the bundle.
Plugin unit suite with a faked Worker; nine malformed-response shapes and every worker terminal event.
In-memory node:fs mock and ts.sys patch so analyzer specs never touch disk; must not import node:fs.
Analyzer suite: six exhaustive type-level maps, deep-frozen shared fixture, exhaustive import-graph and merge rules.
Generator tsconfig; no reference to the protocol package even though the emitted code imports it.

507-line plugin: dirty-name scanner, config-tree baseUrl anchor, cached verdicts, manifest validation without materialising.
Proves manifest validation never touches the input selector or any projection getter.
Integration suite booting a real Loader over a temp node_modules; covers aliases, subpaths, in-flight drops, config-tree anchor.
Loader tsconfig; references app-boot, cordis, loader, schemastery and the registry.
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol with three entries incl. the Zod-free ./remote-info subpath.
Per-heading EN/ZH pairing hashes for the protocol README.
Protocol contract: minimal markers, consumer-owned strictness, resource readers, code-discriminated failures.
Chinese translation of the protocol README.
484-line runtime surface: versioned prototype markers, segment grammar, root-scoped invocation accessor, frozen readers.
Strict lossless-JSON checks: -0 and non-enumerable props rejected, cycles detected, top-level undefined allowed as an item.
Symbol.for-based owned-value wrapper with idempotent disposal and no extra reference count.
principalOf: the non-owner caller identity, undefined for the owner and outside a Remote call.
Type vocabulary of access resources; a mapped union over the merge-extensible resource map.
RemoteError plus remoteErrorOf: structural marker and code, never instanceof, because realms break it.
Lazy Zod-free factory: shared index built on first read, cached strict and normal views, invoke re-resolves the mounted method.
939-line type vocabulary: merge-extensible maps, InvocationDescriptor, RemoteInvocation, RemoteResult, five registry interfaces.
Published-artifact gate: no zod import in lib/, and built vs source Cordis Contexts both recognised.
Fixture that runs the decorators through a real tsx source launcher and throws on a mismatch.
Ownership contract: release once, sibling-bundle recognition, negative marker cases.
Decorator and marker suite: exact prototype shape, non-enumerable descriptor, root-scoped accessor, conflict refusals.
Resource and principal suite with type-level reader inference and @ts-expect-error negative cases.
Lazy-info suite counting getter reads, reference-identical cached index, strict vs normal view separation.
Protocol tsconfig; references util/brand for the branded PeerId type.

Registry contract: atomic fiber-scoped commits, three distinct resolve errors, uncached JSON Schema projection.
Chinese translation of the registry README.
15-line browser face: inject [] and new TypertRegistry(ctx), the same implementation as the Host.
Host entry plus the declare-module augmentation that adds the schema and reflection queries to the contract.
805-line registry: validate-then-commit under one effect, owner-checked withdrawal, contained listener failures, exhaustive validation.
Registry types: contribution, schema factory, records, filters, and the runtime reflection model.
Registry suite: same descriptor object in both registries, exact withdrawal with hasSeen still true, 15 malformed descriptors.
Registry tsconfig; references the protocol as a project so the merge-extensible maps type-check.
